components.name: Primary Coral Button
components.description: The decisive account or next-step action on light and dark fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.35rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .7rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: .85rem 1.55rem; background: var(--coral-action, #d62d47); color: #fff; font: 800 .86rem 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 .8rem 2rem rgba(185,35,58,.22); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary span { transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--coral-dark, #b9233a); box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem rgba(221,47,73,.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover span { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary platform-exploration action that stays visually subordinate to coral.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 3.35rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #cfd1d6; border-radius: 999px; padding: .85rem 1.55rem; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #101119); font: 800 .86rem 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--ink, #101119); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Compact Dark Navigation
components.description: Sticky product-studio navigation with restrained labels and a coral account action.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 4.65rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: rgba(16,17,25,.96); color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font-family: 'Sora Variable', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; } .ds-nav div { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: .5rem 0; color: #d8dae0; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--coral, #ff455f); transition: right 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { right: 0; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 2.65rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: .6rem 1.2rem; background: var(--coral-action, #d62d47); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Market Tabs
components.description: Underline tabs for switching market categories inside an ink product stage.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; padding: .9rem 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #31333d; background: var(--ink, #101119); } .ds-tabs button { flex: 1; min-width: 8rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #a9acb5; padding: .8rem 1rem 1rem; font: 800 .75rem 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { border-color: var(--coral, #ff455f); color: #fff; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Instrument Row
components.description: A compact market-data row used inside product demonstrations.
components.css: .ds-instrument { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: .9rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: .8rem; background: #292b35; color: #fff; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 220ms ease; } .ds-instrument:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #30323d; } .ds-instrument:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-symbol { width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f5f7; color: var(--ink, #101119); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-instrument div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .22rem; } .ds-instrument strong { font-size: .78rem; } .ds-instrument small { color: #9296a2; font-size: .58rem; } .ds-instrument .ds-price { text-align: right; } .ds-instrument .ds-price small { color: var(--green, #11966b); }

components.name: Editorial Benefit Card
components.description: A flat benefit card with an expressive visual field and disciplined editorial copy.
components.html:
↗
CASHBACK

More activity. More back.

Benefits that keep pace as trading activity grows.
components.css: .ds-benefit { overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 29rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: #f5f6f7; color: var(--ink, #101119); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-benefit-visual { min-height: 15rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #dff3fb; color: var(--blue-dark, #0b5a89); font: 700 4rem 'Sora Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-benefit-copy { padding: 2rem; } .ds-benefit-copy small { color: var(--coral-dark, #b9233a); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-benefit-copy h3 { margin: .8rem 0; font: 700 1.7rem/1.1 'Sora Variable', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-benefit-copy p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #626671); font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-benefit:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Market Ticker Cell
components.description: A fixed-width, hairline-divided cell for the illustrative scrolling market strip.
components.css: .ds-ticker-cell { width: 12rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: .3rem .8rem; padding: 1rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dedfe4); background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #101119); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-ticker-cell span, .ds-ticker-cell strong { font-size: .68rem; } .ds-ticker-cell small { grid-column: 2; color: var(--green, #11966b); font-size: .52rem; } .ds-ticker-cell:hover { background: var(--mist, #f3f4f6); } .ds-ticker-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #138fc4); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Axquotes is precise, editorial, approachable, and product-led. It treats the page like a well-organized market desk: generous paper-white fields create room to understand the offer, while concentrated ink-black stages let the platform prove itself with real interface demonstrations. Electric blue makes data and focus legible; coral creates decisive moments of forward motion.

The system avoids interchangeable broker-card marketing. Breadth, tools, benefits, and education are presented as a paced story—understand the offer, see the platform, verify the evidence, then create an account—with interface imagery carrying more authority than decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Clean editorial fields interrupted by immersive product stages.
Decisive Sora headlines paired with highly readable Manrope utility text.
Electric blue for market information and focus; coral for conversion and momentum.
Rounded, dimensional terminal compositions set against structurally flat content.
Compact navigation, visible risk context, and repeated but controlled account actions.

rules.name: The Coral Means Move Rule
rules.body: Reserve coral for conversion, active choice, and deliberate emphasis; it must never become a generic card-decoration color.

rules.name: The Blue Means Information Rule
rules.body: Use blue for data, platform state, links to market understanding, and focus—not as a second CTA color.

rules.name: The Stage-and-Field Rule
rules.body: Paper and mist carry explanation; ink and indigo carry demonstrations, proof, and commitment.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sora makes the argument; Manrope explains, labels, and enables the next action.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Large Sora type uses negative tracking and near-solid leading; do not loosen it into generic marketing typography.

rules.name: The Demonstration Survives Rule
rules.body: At smaller widths, crop, simplify, and reframe the terminal before replacing it with generic illustration or hiding the product story.

rules.name: The Product Earns Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep prose and ordinary cards flat; reserve substantial shadows for controls that move and product layers that demonstrate.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Large scenes use 1rem, nested content uses 0.8rem, compact terminal controls use 0.35–0.5rem, and only actions or true circular indicators use the pill/circle extreme.

dos: Do build pages as a paced editorial story: offer, product proof, breadth and benefits, then account action.
Do preserve the 1240px shell, asymmetric demonstration layouts, and generous section rhythm.
Do keep a visible coral account action in decisive conversion moments, especially the first viewport.
Do use real interface structure—charts, lists, tabs, order states—to explain the platform.
Do maintain visible 3px blue focus outlines, keyboard-operable controls, risk disclosure, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do simplify product scenes responsively while preserving their narrative role.
donts: Don't turn the page into a grid of interchangeable broker feature cards.
Don't use coral and blue as interchangeable decoration; coral moves, blue informs.
Don't spread heavy shadows across ordinary editorial content.
Don't replace product demonstrations with abstract fintech gradients, stock traders, coins, or ornamental market imagery.
Don't loosen Sora headlines, over-round nested controls, or promote every surface to a floating card.
Don't present illustrative prices or interface values as live market data or performance claims.
